snippet.title: Prelude Dark Pain: Kickstarter Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Enjoy the latest trailer for Prelude Dark Pain, the upcoming dark fantasy open-world tactical RPG with more than 20 playable heroes that features music from composer Kumi Tanioka (Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles, Minecraft). 

You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479090/Prelude_Dark_Pain/

#PreludeDarkPain #Kickstarter #Gaming
